The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NBT India Media Coordinator Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Media Coordinator: Graduate in Journalism/mass Communication/Public relations/Media Studies or any other relevant discipline from a recognised University. Minimum 5 years of experience in Media Coordination, Public relations, Corporate Communication or event publicity. Experience of working with Govt. Organisations/Public sector undertakings/Large Scale Events or exhibitions will be desirable.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Media Coordinator: Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Please refer to the official notification for Selection Process details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NBT India Media Coordinator Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NBT India to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NBT India Media Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Book Trust, India (NBT India) for filling up designated positions under their administrative control.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered through NBT India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The National Book Trust, India is recruiting candidates for the post of Media Coordinator through this official notification advertisement number 135/2026/Estt.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Media Coordinator post under the current notification issued by the National Book Trust, India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Media Coordinator?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Graduate degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Media Studies, or any other relevant discipline from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Candidates must check the official notification for any applicable age relaxation guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the Media Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Media Coordinator position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the start and last dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 06-10-2026 and the final date to submit online applications is 21-10-2026 before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NBT India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through online mode by visiting the official website of the National Book Trust, India at www.nbtindia.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job nature and duration of this appointment?
faq.answer: The job is purely on a contract basis through a manpower agency, initially for a period of three months, which may be extended as per requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for downloading the official notification PDF and accessing the online application portal in the Important Links section above.
